subject: general
question: In a certain code language, if 'COMPUTER' is written as 'RETPUMOC*'*, 'NOTEBOOK' is written as 'KOOEBTON', how will 'INTERNET' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Given word is written from the reverse side and middle two alphabet is remain same in all words.**

'COMPUTER' is written as 'RETPUMOC*'*

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d4c892c58308e9c988fc9ff3cffa3cbeeb56ab31f028400822c000297bb45b8.png] 

 'NOTEBOOK' is written as 'KOOEBTON'

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cf2a6c654ec49bd89c692973c4697ab888d730b279031065fe17ad61d72c69a.png] 

Similarly,

For INTERNET

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b181c972d00dd52077a6c75c7177ed781eb4c6ec43030fa03dfa864abc3ca862.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TENERTNI".**
